items.title: 6.4.1 Key Features of the Ellipse (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 190-191: 6.4.1 Key Features of the Ellipse (foci, centre, vertices, co-vertices, symmetry, eccentricity, directrices, latus rectum, parametric form, foci on y-axis), relation of a, b, e, circle, second definition, Figure 6.16, Note

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein humne ellipse ki standard equation derive ki thi. Ab sawal yeh hai ke is equation se ellipse ke ahem hisse (features) kaise pehchanein: foci kahan hain, vertices kahan, ellipse kitna chapta (flat) hai, waghera. Exam mein aksar yahi cheezein poochi jati hain, is liye har feature ko us ki wajah ke saath samjhiye. Neeche kitab ke points hain, aur un ke baad hum har ek ki wajah khol kar dekhenge.

Ek misaal se sochiye: kisi shehar ka naqsha (map) ho to hum pehle us ke ahem muqamaat dhoondte hain, jaise markaz (centre), bare raaste, aur kinare. Ellipse ka bhi yahi haal hai. Centre us ka markaz hai, major axis us ka sab se lamba raasta, minor axis sab se chhota, vertices aur co-vertices us ke kinare, aur foci woh do khaas points jin par poori definition khari hai. Yeh sab ek dafa pehchan liye to graph banana aur sawal hal karna dono aasaan ho jate hain.

items: Foci: foci \((\pm c, 0)\) par hain, jahan \(c^2 = a^2 - b^2\).
Centre: dono foci ko jorne wale segment ka midpoint \(C\) centre kehlata hai. Upar wali equation ke liye centre origin \((0, 0)\) par hai.
Vertices: \(y = 0\) rakhne se \(x = \pm a\) milta hai. Points \(A'(-a, 0)\) aur \(A(a, 0)\) vertices hain. Segment \(A'A\), jis ki lambai \(2a\) hai, major axis (bari axis) hai.

Co-vertices: \(x = 0\) rakhne se \(y = \pm b\) milta hai. Points \(B'(0, -b)\) aur \(B(0, b)\) co-vertices kehlate hain. Segment \(B'B\), lambai \(2b\), minor axis (chhoti axis) hai. Kyunke \(a > b\), major axis minor axis se lambi hai.
Symmetry: \(x\) ki jagah \(-x\) aur \(y\) ki jagah \(-y\) rakhne se equation nahi badalti; is liye ellipse x-axis, y-axis aur origin teeno ke gird symmetric hai.
Eccentricity: ellipse ki eccentricity \(e = \frac{c}{a}\) hai. Kyunke \(a > c > 0\), is liye \(0 < e < 1\).
Directrices: \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) (\(a > b\)) ki do directrices hain, jo vertical lines \(x = \pm\frac{a}{e}\) hain.
Latus Rectum: major axis par perpendicular har focal chord (focus se guzarne wali chord) latus rectum kehlati hai (jama: latera recta). Har latus rectum ki lambai \(\frac{2b^2}{a}\) hai.

Parametric Equations: har real \(\theta\) ke liye point \((a\cos\theta, b\sin\theta)\) ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) par hota hai. Is liye ellipse ki parametric equations \(x = a\cos\theta,\ y = b\sin\theta\) hain.

Foci y-axis par: agar foci \((0, \pm c)\) par hon to \(a\) aur \(b\) ke kirdar badal jate hain, aur equation \(\frac{x^2}{b^2} + \frac{y^2}{a^2} = 1\), \(a > b\) ban jati hai; vertices \((0, \pm a)\) aur co-vertices \((\pm b, 0)\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Teen lengths ko yun yaad rakhiye: \(a\) = centre se vertex tak (lambi taraf), \(b\) = centre se co-vertex tak (chhoti taraf), \(c\) = centre se focus tak. Foci hamesha major axis par aur ellipse ke andar hote hain, kyunke \(c < a\).
Symmetry kyun? Equation mein sirf \(x^2\) aur \(y^2\) hain, aur \((-x)^2 = x^2\). Is liye agar \((x, y)\) curve par hai to \((-x, y)\), \((x, -y)\) aur \((-x, -y)\) bhi curve par honge. Yani ellipse ka ek chautha hissa (quarter) bana lein, baaqi teen aaine (mirror) ki tarah mil jate hain.
Eccentricity ellipse ka 'chaptapan' naapti hai. \(e\) zero ke qareeb ho to foci centre ke paas hain aur ellipse taqreeban circle hai, jaise roti. \(e\) 1 ke qareeb ho to ellipse lamba aur patla hai, jaise cricket ke maidan ka lamba oval.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Latus rectum ki lambai \(\frac{2b^2}{a}\) kahan se aayi? Focus \(F(c, 0)\) se guzarne wala latus rectum vertical line \(x = c\) par hai. Equation mein \(x = c\) rakhein:
\[\frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1 - \frac{c^2}{a^2} = \frac{a^2 - c^2}{a^2} = \frac{b^2}{a^2}\]
to \(y = \pm\frac{b^2}{a}\). Chord \((c, -\frac{b^2}{a})\) se \((c, \frac{b^2}{a})\) tak hai, is liye lambai \(\frac{2b^2}{a}\). Ratta lagane ki zaroorat nahi, yeh do line ka hisaab hai.
Point \((a\cos\theta, b\sin\theta)\) ellipse par kyun hai? Rakh kar dekhiye: \(\frac{a^2\cos^2\theta}{a^2} + \frac{b^2\sin^2\theta}{b^2} = \cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta = 1\). Yani \(\theta\) jo bhi ho, point ellipse par hi rehta hai. Aage maximum aur minimum wale sawalon mein yeh parametric point bohat kaam aata hai.
Directrices \(x = \pm\frac{a}{e}\) ellipse ke bahar hain, kyunke \(e < 1\) se \(\frac{a}{e} > a\). Yani directrix vertex se bhi aage hoti hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Sawal 1: \(\frac{x^2}{36} + \frac{y^2}{20} = 1\) mein \(c\) kitna hai? (\(c^2 = 36 - 20 = 16\), to \(c = 4\).) Ab bataiye \(e\) kya hai? (\(\frac{4}{6} = \frac{2}{3}\).)
Sawal 2: kya kisi ellipse ki eccentricity \(\frac{3}{2}\) ho sakti hai? (Nahi, kyunke \(c < a\) hamesha, is liye \(e < 1\).)
Sawal 3: agar \(a\) wohi rahe aur \(b\) chhota hota jaye to ellipse ka kya hoga? (Woh patla hota jayega, \(c\) barhega aur \(e\) 1 ki taraf jayega.)
In sawalon ke jawab pehle khud sochiye, phir brackets mein dekhiye. Is tarah ke chhote sawal khud se poochna feature yaad karne ka sab se achha tareeqa hai.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text:
Horizontal hai ya vertical? Denominators dekhiye. Bara denominator hamesha \(a^2\) hai. Agar woh \(x^2\) ke neeche ho to major axis x-axis par hai; agar \(y^2\) ke neeche ho to y-axis par.
Misaal: \(\frac{x^2}{16} + \frac{y^2}{25} = 1\) mein bara number 25 \(y^2\) ke neeche hai, to \(a = 5\), \(b = 4\), \(c = 3\); foci \((0, \pm 3)\) aur vertices \((0, \pm 5)\).
Relation between a, b and e: \(b^2 = a^2 - c^2\) mein \(c = ae\) rakhein (kyunke \(e = \frac{c}{a}\)), to \(b^2 = a^2 - a^2e^2 = a^2(1 - e^2)\).
bold: Relation between a, b and e:

blocks.text: Circle as a Special Case: agar dono foci ek hi jagah aa jayein to \(c = 0\) aur \(a = b\); ellipse radius \(r = a = b\) wala circle ban jata hai, jis ki equation \(x^2 + y^2 = a^2\) hai. Zahir hai ke circle ke liye \(e = 0\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Rishta \(b^2 = a^2(1 - e^2)\) us waqt kaam aata hai jab \(a\) aur \(e\) diye hon: \(c\) nikale baghair seedha \(b\) mil jata hai. Circle mein dono foci centre par mil jate hain, to \(c = 0\) aur \(e = 0\). Yani circle sab se 'gol' ellipse hai, jis ka chaptapan zero hai.

Second definition of ellipse: ellipse ki ek doosri definition bhi hai. Agar koi point \(P\) is tarah chale ke us ka ek fixed point \(F\) (focus) se faasla, aur ek fixed seedhi line (directrix) se faasla, in dono ki nisbat (ratio) hamesha ek constant \(e\) rahe (jo 1 se kam ho), to \(P\) ka locus (raasta) eccentricity \(e\) wala ellipse hai.
Yani agar \(\frac{|PF|}{|PM|} = e\), jahan \(0 < e < 1\), to \(P\) ka locus ellipse hai. Yahan \(M\) directrix par \(P\) se giraye gaye perpendicular ka paaon (foot) hai.

blocks.alt: Pale yellow panel par magenta ellipse aur andar focus F. Ellipse ka point P cyan line se F se jura hai (us par e likha hai) aur cyan line se directrix ke paon M tak (us par 1 likha hai); directrix daayen taraf magenta khari line hai (dono siron par teer), M par right angle ka nishan.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.16: |PF| : |PM| = e : 1 (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 6.16)

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Ellipse ki equation is doosri definition se bhi derive ki ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh focus-directrix wali definition hai, bilkul parabola jaisi. Farq sirf nisbat ka hai: parabola mein \(|PF| = |PM|\) (nisbat 1), aur ellipse mein \(|PF|\) hamesha \(|PM|\) ka ek fixed hissa \(e\) hota hai, jo 1 se kam hai. (Aage hyperbola mein yeh nisbat 1 se ziyada hogi.)
Vertex \(A(a, 0)\) par check kijiye, focus \(F(ae, 0)\) aur directrix \(x = \frac{a}{e}\) ke saath: \(|AF| = a - ae = a(1 - e)\) aur \(|AM| = \frac{a}{e} - a = \frac{a(1 - e)}{e}\). Divide karein to \(\frac{|AF|}{|AM|} = e\). Definition bilkul poori utarti hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Note kehta hai ke equation is doosri definition se bhi ban sakti hai. Aaiye mukhtasar dekhte hain, taa ke yaqeen ho jaye ke dono definitions ek hi curve deti hain. Focus \(F(ae, 0)\) aur directrix \(x = \frac{a}{e}\) lein. Point \(P(x, y)\) ke liye \(|PF|^2 = (x - ae)^2 + y^2\) aur \(|PM| = \frac{a}{e} - x\), is liye \(e^2|PM|^2 = (a - ex)^2\).
Shart \(|PF|^2 = e^2|PM|^2\) likhein:
\[(x - ae)^2 + y^2 = (a - ex)^2\]
Dono taraf khol kar \(-2aex\) cancel ho jata hai, aur bachta hai:
\[x^2(1 - e^2) + y^2 = a^2(1 - e^2)\]
Ab \(a^2(1 - e^2)\) se divide karein aur \(b^2 = a^2(1 - e^2)\) rakhein; wohi \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) aa jati hai. Matlab dono definitions bilkul ek hi ellipse banati hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Har feature ko equation se khud nikalne ka tareeqa yaad rakhiye, phir kuch ratta nahi lagana parega:
Vertices: curve x-axis ko kahan kaat'ta hai? \(y = 0\) rakhiye. Co-vertices: curve y-axis ko kahan kaat'ta hai? \(x = 0\) rakhiye.
Foci: \(c^2 = a^2 - b^2\) se \(c\) nikaliye, phir focus centre se major axis par \(c\) faasle par.
Eccentricity: \(c\) ko \(a\) se divide kijiye. Directrix: \(a\) ko \(e\) se divide kijiye, aur yeh line major axis par perpendicular hoti hai.
Parametric angle \(\theta\) ko aise sochiye jaise ghari ki sui ghoom rahi ho: \(\theta = 0\) par point vertex \((a, 0)\) par hai, \(\theta = 90^\circ\) par co-vertex \((0, b)\) par, aur \(\theta\) ke poora chakkar lagane par point poora ellipse ghoom aata hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{25} + \frac{y^2}{9} = 1\) ke saare features nikaliye. Bara denominator 25, \(x^2\) ke neeche, to major axis x-axis par: \(a = 5\), \(b = 3\).
\(c^2 = 25 - 9 = 16\), \(c = 4\). Foci \((\pm 4, 0)\), vertices \((\pm 5, 0)\), co-vertices \((0, \pm 3)\).
\(e = \frac{4}{5}\), directrices \(x = \pm\frac{5}{4/5} = \pm\frac{25}{4}\), latus rectum \(\frac{2(9)}{5} = \frac{18}{5}\).
Tasdeeq: \(b^2 = a^2(1 - e^2) = 25(1 - \frac{16}{25}) = 9\). Sahi.
Khud sochiye: \(\frac{x^2}{9} + \frac{y^2}{25} = 1\) ke foci kahan honge? (Jawab: \((0, \pm 4)\), kyunke ab bara denominator \(y^2\) ke neeche hai.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
\(\frac{x^2}{a^2} + \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\), \(a > b\): vertices \((\pm a, 0)\), co-vertices \((0, \pm b)\), foci \((\pm c, 0)\), \(c^2 = a^2 - b^2\).
Major axis \(2a\), minor axis \(2b\), \(e = \frac{c}{a}\), \(0 < e < 1\), aur \(b^2 = a^2(1 - e^2)\).
Directrices \(x = \pm\frac{a}{e}\) (ellipse ke bahar), latus rectum \(\frac{2b^2}{a}\), parametric point \((a\cos\theta, b\sin\theta)\).
Bara denominator \(y^2\) ke neeche ho to har \(x\) wala feature \(y\) wala ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
Har dafa \(x^2\) ke neeche wale number ko \(a^2\) samajh lena. \(a^2\) hamesha bara denominator hai, chahe kahin bhi ho.
Directrix ko \(x = \pm ae\) likh dena. \(x = \pm ae\) to focus hai; directrix \(x = \pm\frac{a}{e}\) hai.
Latus rectum \(\frac{2a^2}{b}\) likh dena; sahi \(\frac{2b^2}{a}\) hai (jo chhota hai).
\(e\) ko 1 se bara likh dena: ellipse mein yeh kabhi nahi hota. Agar aap ka \(e > 1\) aa raha hai to \(a\) aur \(c\) ulat gaye hain.
